headline: President Trump signed an executive order about the United States' role in the security of the Middle Eastern country of Qatar.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with U.S. support for the security of the State of Qatar. No official summary was provided, so the specific actions, commitments, or instructions to federal agencies in the order cannot be described here.
